question: Which divine aspects are located on the left side of the deity’s own form?
premises: The reference point is the deity’s own left side.
Tatpuruṣa is mentioned in that context.
Aghora and Īśāna are also named.
inference: The verse places Tatpuruṣa, Aghora, and Īśāna in relation to the deity’s left side.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation among the three names is compressed in this verse.
plain_english: On his own left side, Tatpuruṣa, Aghora, and Īśāna.
